title: Network-Based Pharmacology and Bioinformatics Study on the Mechanism of Action of Gujiansan in the Treatment of Steroid-Induced Avascular Necrosis of the Femoral Head.
authors: Ren, Guo-Wu; Wen, Shuai-Bo; Han, Jie; Xu, Zhi-Wei; Qi, Wen; Shang, Yu-Zhi; Wu, Yu-Kun
one_liner_zh: 该文为中药古健散治疗激素性股骨头坏死的网络药理学研究，虽涉及DNA结合转录因子活性调控和分子对接，但核心是药物-疾病靶点网络，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To investigate the main pharmacological basis and mechanism of action of Gujiansan in the treatment of steroid-induced avascular necrosis of the femoral head (SANFH). METHODS: The active constituents and targets of Gujiansan were screened by using TCMSP and other databases, and relevant disease targets were obtained by analyzing the microarray of SANFH in the GEO database. The intersection of the two was taken to obtain the potential targets of Gujiansan for the treatment of SANFH, and key active constituents were screened with the "active constituent-target" network constructed by the Cytoscape software; then, the STRING database was used to construct the protein interaction network to screen the key targets. The Gene Ontology and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes enrichment analyses of key targets were performed by the DAVID database, and the relationship between the "key active constituent-key target-key signaling pathway" was explored. Finally, the molecular docking between key active constituents and key targets was verified. In addition, qPCR detection technology was used to evaluate the preventive and therapeutic effects of key active constituents of Gujiansan in a rat osteoblast model of SANFH to verify the possible mechanism of the effect of Gujiansan in the treatment of SANFH. RESULTS: (1) 106 active constituents and 55 targets were obtained for the treatment of SANFH. (2) Quercetin, luteolin, kaempferol, cryptotanshinone, and naringenin were the key active constituents for the treatment of SANFH. (3) IL1B, STAT3, CAT, PTGS2, and MAPK3 were the key targets for the treatment of SANFH. (4) IL1B, STAT3, CAT, PTGS2, MAPK3, and HMOX1 are key targets in the protein interaction network. (5) DAVID enrichment analysis mainly covers the regulation of DNA-binding transcription factor activity, positive regulation of cytokine production, and response to oxidative stress and other biological processes, involving IL-17, AGE-RAGE, C-type lectin receptor, and other signaling pathways. (6) Gujiansan is a multitarget and multisignaling pathway for the treatment of SANFH. (7) Good binding activity exists between key active constituents and key targets. CONCLUSION: This study analyzes the potential mechanism of action of Gujiansan in the treatment of SANFH with network pharmacology, which can provide a reference for the further study of its pharmacological basis and targets.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨骨健散治疗激素性股骨头坏死（SANFH）的主要药理学基础及作用机制。方法：利用TCMSP等数据库筛选骨健散的活性成分及靶点，并通过分析GEO数据库中SANFH的微阵列获得相关疾病靶点。取两者交集得到骨健散治疗SANFH的潜在靶点，利用Cytoscape软件构建“活性成分-靶点”网络筛选关键活性成分；随后，利用STRING数据库构建蛋白相互作用网络以筛选关键靶点。通过DAVID数据库对关键靶点进行基因本体论（Gene Ontology）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes）富集分析，并探讨“关键活性成分-关键靶点-关键信号通路”之间的关系。最后，验证关键活性成分与关键靶点之间的分子对接。此外，采用qPCR检测技术评估骨健散关键活性成分在大鼠成骨细胞SANFH模型中的预防和治疗效果，以验证骨健散治疗SANFH的可能机制。结果：（1）获得106个活性成分和55个治疗SANFH的靶点。（2）槲皮素、木犀草素、山奈酚、隐丹参酮和柚皮素是治疗SANFH的关键活性成分。（3）IL1B、STAT3、CAT、PTGS2和MAPK3是治疗SANFH的关键靶点。（4）IL1B、STAT3、CAT、PTGS2、MAPK3和HMOX1是蛋白相互作用网络中的关键靶点。（5）DAVID富集分析主要涵盖DNA结合转录因子活性的调控、细胞因子产生的正调控、氧化应激反应等生物过程，涉及IL-17、AGE-RAGE、C型凝集素受体等信号通路。（6）骨健散是多靶点、多信号通路治疗SANFH的药物。（7）关键活性成分与关键靶点之间存在良好的结合活性。结论：本研究通过网络药理学分析了骨健散治疗SANFH的潜在作用机制，可为其药理学基础和靶点的进一步研究提供参考。
